subject: biology
title: A Balanced Plate
welcome_lead: Build a meal from the seven nutrient groups your body needs to thrive.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on nutrients and a balanced diet.
final_note: You can now name seven nutrients and explain why you need each one.

concepts.def: Main energy source like bread or rice.
Store energy and insulate the body.
Like iron and calcium for body parts.
Helps food move through the gut.

walkthroughs.body_html: Your body needs carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, water and fibre. A meal should include the right balance of each.
The eat well plate shows large amounts of fruit, vegetables and starchy carbs, smaller amounts of protein and dairy, and only a little of fats and sugars.
Carbs give energy. Proteins build muscles. Fats store energy. Vitamins and minerals keep cells healthy. Fibre keeps the gut moving. Water carries everything around.
